title: ESMC-MonoYield predicts monomeric protein yield in E. coli from sequence
summary: A pooled assay combining peptide barcodes, size-exclusion chromatography and mass spectrometry measured monomeric yield for over 39,000 protein domain variants, de novo proteins and nanobodies in E. coli. The data were used to benchmark inverse-folding methods and structure-confidence metrics, and to fine-tune the protein language model ESMC into ESMC-MonoYield. The abstract states that it prospectively enriched high-yield candidates among BindCraft-designed binders, but gives no effect size.
ai_technology: ESMC protein language model fine-tuned to predict monomeric yield from sequence

evidence.tested: Prospective experimental test of yield enrichment among BindCraft binders, plus the 39,000-variant dataset.
evidence.unknown: Magnitude of enrichment and performance on other protein classes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The fine-tuned language model ranked designs by predicted yield.
